propositions: Production Python code under src/rebar exceeds Ruff C901 threshold (max-complexity=15) with 69 functions over the limit; a shrink-only baseline gate must track and bound existing debt without blocking all changes.

Raw Ruff exits 1 on production findings; the wrapper must distinguish diagnostic-bearing operation (valid C901 JSON, exit 0 or 1 with --exit-zero) from scanner failure (missing Ruff, exit 2+, invalid JSON).

Baseline JSON schema with schema_version, sorted ceilings keyed by repo-relative-POSIX-path::qualified-AST-symbol (e.g., src/rebar/file.py::Class.method), rejects unknown fields, duplicates, and unsorted keys; ceilings must be integers > 15.

Four mutually exclusive counters (active, new, increased, stale) assess each finding against the baseline; new or increased debt makes --check exit nonzero, stale improvements exit zero, and --update-stale can only lower or remove entries, refusing regression.

Maintenance mode --update-stale uses fsutil.atomic_write to write canonical sorted JSON, leaves target bytes unchanged on injected write/replace failures, and refuses new/increased debt or scanner errors.
make lint wires the complexity wrapper check over src/rebar (production only) while retaining existing Ruff and format checks over src and tests; wrapper failure blocks the lint gate.
